resources.string: Stream audio from this phone live to a PC on your Wi-Fi network. The PC plays it through its own speakers and nothing is saved there.
No receivers found. Start the OfflinePlaya receiver on your PC, on the same Wi-Fi network.
1. Install the receiver on your computer
OfflinePlaya Receiver is a small free app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Download it from the project page on GitHub — no account needed.
2. Put both on the same Wi-Fi
Start the receiver and approve your computer's firewall prompt so the phone can reach it. The phone then finds it by itself.
Pick your computer in the list and tap Connect. Audio moves to its speakers while play, pause and skip stay on the phone. Tap Disconnect to bring the sound back.
The stream is lossless over Wi-Fi, but the computer plays it through its own audio mixer — so the phone's equaliser, preamp and crossfade are bypassed in this mode.
Get the receiver for your computer
The download runs on your computer, not your phone, so send this link over there — or just type it into your computer's browser:
Get the free OfflinePlaya Receiver for your PC, Mac or Linux and play your phone's music through your computer's speakers: %1$s
